jobs.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: official FinFolk full-wordmark master, transparent background. Edit ONLY the supplied screenshot. Precisely extract the complete existing lowercase 'finfolk' graphic as it appears in the screenshot. Preserve ALL seven letters' exact silhouette, proportions, spacing, slight tilts, swollen tops, thin waists, flared feet, and the small oval negative-space sucker marks inside the FIRST f. This is the approved official wordmark; do not redesign or substitute fonts, and do not change the graphic's letter case. Remove the ivory background, leaving the interior holes and spaces genuinely transparent. Render uniform solid midnight navy #172440 with crisp clean antialiased edges, centred on a landscape canvas around 1536x640 with narrow equal clear margins and no clipping. Exactly one complete wordmark; no separate f, no subheading, no label, no decorative pattern, no frame, no shadows, no gradient. It must visually match the supplied screenshot.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: 1024x1024 original all-over marine-creature textile for the FinFolk regional Nasties collection. Sophisticated flat printed illustration, no faux paper texture, no 3D, no gradients, no text, no borders, no isolated mascot, no human figures or other species. Preserve recognisable animal anatomy and the quality and character of the reference prints.
